card.name: N/A and yes in table cells
card.fires_on: The last piece of a table entry meaning not available or not applicable, such as the A in N/A or the word applicable after na = not. It also fires on a yes in a plant trait list.

modes.label: N/A in tables
modes.description: The A closing N/A in a row of dose or organ values.
modes.example: Heart wall 0.0039 N/A N/A N<> N/A Kidneys 0.0

modes.label: Not applicable
modes.description: The word applicable in an abbreviation key for na.
modes.example: na = not<< applicable>>. RT/L = Ambient room temperature and

modes.label: Yes in trait list
modes.description: A yes value after a label such as Heat Tolerant.
modes.example: Heat Tolerant:<< yes>> Soil Description: Various well-dr
